ideas.idea: Prerender/SSR Catalogue so product data is in initial HTML instead of client fetch
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches /api/mugs in useEffect, so non-JS crawlers see no products.

ideas.idea: Add error handling to the Catalogue fetch
ideas.why: Accurate, but it has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Per-route unique titles and head management (React 19 native tags or helmet)
ideas.why: Both routes share one placeholder title and need distinct per-route head tags.
index.html has no viewport meta, which affects mobile rendering and indexing.

ideas.idea: Add canonical, Open Graph and Twitter tags
ideas.why: Valid but standard boilerplate with modest effect for this small site.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD Organization/WebSite on Home and ItemList/Product on Catalogue
ideas.why: This is a product catalogue, so Product structured data suits it, though the markup would need prerendering to be visible to crawlers.

ideas.idea: Add width/height and fetchpriority to hero image
ideas.why: Accurate for the hero img, but a minor performance tweak.

ideas.idea: Add substantive content to Home (materials, care, shipping, maker story)
ideas.why: Home has only one H1 and one sentence, so facts like materials and shipping would give crawlers and people more to read.
A mandatory FAQ is folklore and not a real requirement.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own product route/URL with links, images, prices, in a ul/li list
ideas.why:

names with no per-product pages to find or cite.

ideas.idea: Make the Catalogue H1 more descriptive
Add a 404 catch-all route and real 404 status
ideas.why: The router has no wildcard route, so unknown URLs render only the nav, and an SPA host would likely serve them as 200.
llms.txt is folklore as a way to be found.
Applies to almost any site and has little discoverability impact.
